title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 3.2 Calculus of Vector-Valued Functions: Write an expression for the derivative of a vector-valued function.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 3.2 Calculus of Vector-Valued Functions: Write an expression for the derivative of a vector-valued function.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, section "3.2 Calculus of Vector-Valued Functions", prints these objectives: "Write an expression for the derivative of a vector-valued function." "Find the tangent vector at a point for a given position vector." "Find the unit tangent vector at a point for a given position vector and explain its significance." "Calculate the definite integral of a vector-valued function.". The section text says: "To study the calculus of vector-valued functions, we follow a similar path to the one we took in studying real-valued functions. First, we define the derivative, then we examine applications of the derivative , then we move on to defining integrals. However, we will find some interesting new ideas along the way as a result of the vector nature of these functions and the properties of space curves." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
